blocks.title: The Constructor Mystery
blocks.text: "The problem you identified is exactly why we need constructors," Maya explained. "A constructor is a special method that runs automatically when we create an object. It's where we set up the initial state." Alex looked puzzled. "But I don't see any constructor in our User class." "That's because Java provides a default constructor automatically if we don't write one. But the default constructor doesn't do much - it just creates an empty object."
